expectations.text: Rejects the points, badges, and leaderboard scheme for an audience that meets once a year, rather than tuning its parameters.
expectations.evidence: "don't ship the points system as designed."

expectations.text: States that the scheme measures posting volume, which is not the outcome the space exists for (people returning to the next edition, some bringing work).
expectations.evidence: "They measure posting, not the outcome."

expectations.text: States that the scheme rewards the loudest members rather than the returning ones.
expectations.evidence: "They reward the loudest members, not the returning ones."

expectations.text: States that the scheme demands maintenance in exactly the months the team has no hours.
expectations.evidence: "They need upkeep in exactly the months nobody has hours."

expectations.text: Replaces it with a small ladder of named steps (attendee, regular, contributor shaped), each step with a stated way in and a stated reward.
expectations.evidence: Table with Rung, Way in (asynchronous), Reward columns.

expectations.text: Requires every step above the first to be climbable entirely asynchronously, because an annual event gives one live touch per year.
expectations.evidence: "participation ladder that works asynchronously"; one live touch a year.

expectations.text: Requires each step's way in to work without personally knowing an organizer, so the ladder is not a clique with a diagram.
expectations.evidence: "Every rung needs a way in that doesn't require knowing an organizer. Otherwise it is a clique with a diagram."

expectations.text: Requires asking consent before publishing anyone's name or photo as a champion or regular, with an opt-out that needs no explanation.
expectations.evidence: "Ask before naming anyone, and offer an opt-out."

expectations.text: Routes the 'feed people toward helping organize' endpoint to the team-structure candidate flag, and stops the ladder there rather than building organizer recruitment into the community mechanism.
expectations.evidence: "Flagged to event-team-structure; this skill stops here"

expectations.text: Scopes the mechanism to non-volunteer members, with volunteer recognition handled by its own separate loop.
expectations.evidence: "Scoped to non-volunteer members." and volunteers to event-volunteer-experience.

expectations.text: Reports ladder movement as a raw count of members who moved a step, never as a rate or percentage.

expectations.text: Ties success to attendees returning next edition rather than to posting frequency, streaks, or leaderboard positions.
